notes: AEAT Manual practico IVA 2024, Capitulo 6 'Los regimenes especiales en el IVA', 'Regimen especial del grupo de entidades', worked example (pag. 199-200): 'Sociedad DELTA, S.A.: IVA devengado: 1.000 / IVA deducible: 2.000 / Resultado autoliquidacion: -1.000'. DELTA, S.A. is the entidad dependiente of the group (60% owned by OMEGA, S.A.). The manual states only the aggregate IVA devengado/deducible/resultado per society (no base or rate-tier breakdown); the underlying calendar year is not stated explicitly in the example (illustrative), grounded here against the manual's own 2024 edition and the modelo revision applicable from 2008-y-siguientes onward. See test_m322_2024_grupo_entidades_manual_worked_example.py, which feeds the printed cuota totals to the registry as IvaLedgerObservation rows and grades iva.cuota-devengada-total / iva.cuota-deducible-total / iva.resultado-regimen-general against the manual's own printed figures. This scenario is also the negative-resultado case (a credit / a compensar member within the group).
